sentences.text:
In the matter of : Kalyani Ghorai @ Karuna Rani Ghor  
 Mr. Soumya Nag,
 Ms. Namrata Chatterjee,
 ....For the Petitioners.
 Ms. Minoti Gomes,
 Ms. Nahid Ahmed  ... For the State.

1. 
The learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are innocent and they have been falsely implicated.
2. The learned Counsel for the State has produced the case diary and opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

3. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of involvement of the present petitioners who appear to be the grandmother-in-law and married sister-in-law and having regard to the fact that there is no overt act alleged against the petitioners in the commission of the alleged offence, we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioners is not necessary.

4. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners, namely, Kalyani Ghorai @
Karuna Rani Ghorai and Barnali Ghorai, shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Kalyani Ghorai @ Karuna Rani Ghorai & Anr vs Unknown

1973 corresponding to Section 482 (2) of the BNSS, 2023.
5.
It is directed that the petitioners shall cooperate with the investigation till the submission of the final report.

6. It is further directed that the petitioners shall appear before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Purba Medinipur in connection with G.R. Case No.1813 of 2024 within two weeks from date.
7. Accordingly, the application for anticipatory bail is disposed of.
8. All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
